task: Confirm producer, page host, author/editor, self-produced versus external mention, and language for each high-removal source.
done_when: Every top source has a cited role decision or explicit unresolved status.
claim_boundary: A webpage domain or actor citation is not authorship or coordination.

task: Classify high-removal sources by document family, event-list structure, year, and source-selection route.
done_when: S004 is compared with sources of similar document form and coverage, not only with actor-node deletion.
claim_boundary: Document coverage and actor deletion are different units and not matched counterfactuals.

task: Collect own-site, archived-site, bilingual material, legal/professional support, staff and publication-history indicators for a matched actor sample.
done_when: Each field has dated source evidence, missingness, and a human-reviewed coding rule.
claim_boundary: Do not infer capacity from actor class, source count, or issue degree alone.

task: Build formed/active/renamed/merged/dissolved/last-observed intervals with right-censoring and task-completion exits.
done_when: Matched cases distinguish dissolution, planned sunset, merger, renaming, archival silence and current activity.
claim_boundary: Online silence is not organizational death; temporary committees are not failed organizations.

task: Re-estimate visibility after separating co-signing/event rosters from independently sourced actor-issue observations.
done_when: Sensitivity is reported by source family and event rather than projecting lists into stable organization ties.
claim_boundary: Co-listing is event participation, not alliance or coordination.

task: Decide whether H1 remains a Phase-1 methods correction or merits a second-wave methods paper pilot.
done_when: Decision cites leave-one-out concentration, unit mismatch, source-role review and lifecycle feasibility.
claim_boundary: Current evidence supports source dependence, not documentation capacity causing centrality.
